data.one_liner: Drop‑in replacement for SliverList/ListView that handles large, variable‑extent lists and supports jump/animate to items.
data.what_it_does: SuperSliverList and SuperListView provide high‑performance scrolling for very large lists with items of varying heights. They add reliable jump and animate APIs and smoother scrollbar behavior compared to the standard SliverList/ListView.
use_when: Need to display thousands or millions of items with different heights
Require programmatic jump or animation to a specific index
Want predictable scrollbar movement in complex scroll views
avoid_when: Only small, fixed‑height lists where standard SliverList/ListView is sufficient
Projects that already use scrollable_positioned_list and accept its limitations
strengths: Excellent performance with large, variable‑height lists
Drop‑in API compatible with existing code
weaknesses: No documented support for sticky headers (though example shows some support)
Requires manual provision of ScrollController for jump/animate

alternatives.name: scrollable_positioned_list
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides jump/animate to items but uses a custom scroll view and has performance issues with variable‑height items

data.minimal_example:
SuperListView.builder(
  itemCount: 1000,
  itemBuilder: (context, index) => ListTile(title: Text('Item $index')),
)
